description: Read-only view of a Notion-style page returned by INotionDataProvider. Implement a mutable class or record that satisfies this interface in your data layer.

properties.name: ParentId
properties.description: Parent page ID, or null for root-level pages.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Page title shown in the header and sidebar.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Optional short description shown below the title.

properties.name: IconEmoji
properties.description: Emoji character used as the page icon (e.g. "📄"). Shown in sidebar and header.

properties.name: IconImageUrl
properties.description: URL of an image icon. Takes precedence over IconEmoji when both are set.

properties.name: CoverImageUrl
properties.description: URL of the page's cover image (full-width banner at the top).

properties.name: CoverImagePositionY
properties.description: Vertical offset (0–100) for cover image positioning.

properties.name: IsFullWidth
properties.description: When true the page content uses the full container width.

properties.name: IsSmallText
properties.description: When true the editor uses a smaller base font size.

properties.name: IsLocked
properties.description: When true all editing is disabled (read-only mode).

properties.name: CreatedAt
properties.description: UTC timestamp when the page was created.

properties.name: CreatedByUserId
properties.description: ID of the user who created the page.

properties.name: LastEditedAt
properties.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit.

properties.name: LastEditedByUserId
properties.description: ID of the user who made the last edit.

properties.name: IsDeleted
properties.description: True when the page is in the Trash.

properties.name: DeletedAt
properties.description: UTC timestamp when the page was soft-deleted.

properties.name: IsFavorite
properties.description: True when the current user has starred this page.
